chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
A man's kindness to his child is his kindness to his own parents.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man, referring to a person acting within family relations
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بِرُّ: kindness, dutiful goodness, and righteous conduct

ai.seo_question: How is kindness to one's children related to honoring one's parents in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that showing kindness to one's children is deeply connected to honoring one's own parents. It highlights the continuity of family virtue and the moral bond that links generations through righteous conduct.
